diagram_math_checks.result: P = projective n-space over k times_k Y, with i:X→P a closed immersion, p:P→Y projection and f=p∘i, exactly as the Statement and step 1.1. The three K_0 objects are coherent Grothendieck groups and the three Chow objects are total A^*(S)_Q for S=X,P,Y.

i_!:K_0(X)→K_0(P) and p_!:K_0(P)→K_0(Y) are the proper coherent K pushforwards defined in def-pushforward-in-algebraic-k-theory. The exact closed-immersion direct image identifies i_! with the K-theory i_* used by L1. i_*:A^*(X)_Q→A^*(P)_Q and p_*:A^*(P)_Q→A^*(Y)_Q are the proper Chow pushforwards used by L3. All these arrows follow X→P→Y; no contravariant pullbacks are drawn. Chow pushforward preserves cycle dimension; the text explicitly avoids claiming codimension preservation.

Each horizontal map is tau_S:K_0(S)→A^*(S)_Q, alpha↦ch(alpha)td(T_S), precisely the Statement. Thus the diagram does not assert uncorrected Chern-character compatibility. Rational coefficients occur at every Chow node and are not silently imposed on K_0.

tau_P i_! = i_* tau_X is exactly L1 in Todd-tangent form, supplied by the equivalent identity in thm-rr-for-regular-embeddings. That supplier uses the exact normal sequence and Todd multiplicativity; the figure adds no tangent-bundle splitting assertion.
tau_Y p_! = p_* tau_P is exactly L2 and the Statement of thm-rr-for-projective-space-projections for P=projective n-space times_k Y.

Pasting yields tau_Y p_! i_! = p_* i_* tau_X. Functoriality of the two proper pushforwards in L3 identifies these composites with tau_Y f_! and f_* tau_X, exactly step 2.1. The explanation is limited to the given factorization and supplies no stronger naturality statement.
